name: Webspot

sources.title: Homepage — active web discovery directory; categories, upvotes, Featured/Top Voted/Latest sections; pitches 'one listing puts your site in front of Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity'
Pricing — Free $0 (3 dofollow links, requires backlink to Webspot, 30-day review), Growth $12.99 one-time (immediate), Premium $44.99 (badge + featured)
Submit route — renders an account login wall (email/password, Google, GitHub); account required before submitting

conditions: Free tier requires a reciprocal backlink to Webspot (a 'featured badge' linking back to your listing) verified by them
Free listings sit in a 30-day review queue; paying $12.99 skips it
An account (email, Google, or GitHub) is required before the submit form opens
requirements: For the free plan: place Webspot's badge/backlink on your site — they run a 'Verify backlink' check
Free plan: expect up to 30 days for review and listing
preparation: Product name, URL, description, categories/tags (they have a deep tag taxonomy)
A page where the Webspot badge/backlink can live if using the free tier
workflow: Complete the submission form (fields gated behind login)
Choose plan: Free (add their backlink/badge first, then wait ≤30 days) or pay $12.99 for immediate listing
If free: add the featured badge to your site and use their 'Verify backlink' step
Listing appears as a details page with upvotes and a 'Visit Website' link
watchFor: The free tier's cost is a reciprocal link — decide whether a 'Featured on Webspot' badge fits your site
Free review can take up to 30 days and comes with 'no customer support'
'3 dofollow links' is the headline promise — treat AI-assistant-visibility claims ('show up in ChatGPT/Claude answers') as marketing
Listings carry upvote counts; engagement appears modest (top items show single-digit votes)
countsAsLive: A public details page exists on webspot.app for the site, browsable via search/category/tag pages, with a Visit Website link
unknowns: Exact submission form fields (gated behind account creation)
How strictly the reciprocal-backlink requirement is enforced/re-checked over time
Real referral traffic — vote counts suggest low community activity
